name: Piloswine
description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.
